haiku-low.q1: Sign-in still works. Identity is Google's sub, so the user reaches their account. The stored email is never overwritten from Google.
haiku-low.q2: The user must enter the existing account's password on the confirm page. A correct password links the Google account, deletes the pending link, then calls start_session.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins. At 5, the account locks for 15 minutes, the count resets to 0, the pending link is deleted, and the user returns to login.
haiku-low.q4: No match: create a passwordless user with email_verified_at set, insert the user_identities row, and start a session. Unverified: return to login saying use email and password, creating nothing.
haiku-low.q5: Error page, nothing changes. The state expires after 10 minutes, and a repeated callback fails because the state was already deleted by GETDEL.
haiku-low.q6: A new session row and a new sid cookie, with a 14-day lifetime. Any existing sid session row is deleted first, so the old cookie's session is removed.
haiku-low.q7: No password and no email match is required. The browser must still be signed in as the starting user. If the sub belongs to another user, the link is refused back to settings.
haiku-low.q8: In Redis under key goog:state:<state>, with a 10-minute TTL. The callback removes it with GETDEL, or the TTL expires it. Nonce and PKCE verifier are in the same entry.
haiku-low.q9: Redis key goog:link:<id> holds the user id, sub, next path and time. The browser holds only the id in a short HttpOnly cookie. Confirm success, lockout, or TTL expiry deletes it.
haiku-low.q10: In the PostgreSQL table user_identities. Unique keys on (provider, sub) and on (user_id, provider) enforce one Google account per user and one user per Google account.
haiku-low.q11: Failed exchange: back to the start page saying could not finish, try again; nothing stored, and the user starts again. Invalid ID token: error page. No retry is stated.
haiku-low.q12: The attempt record stores the entry point. Settings attempts also store the user id, and the callback checks the browser is still signed in as that user, else shows the error page.

sonnet.q1: They reach their existing account. Identity is by sub, so a changed Google email doesn't matter; the sub is linked, so start_session runs. Our stored email is never overwritten.
sonnet.q2: The user must confirm that account's password. A pending link (user id, sub, next path) is saved in Redis for 10 min with its id in a cookie; on the confirm page, a correct password resets failed_logins, inserts the user_identities row, deletes the pending link, then start_session. (Only if the user doesn't already have a different Google account; then refused.)
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins. At 5 the account is locked for 15 min, the count resets to 0, and the pending link is deleted; user returns to login page with 'Account temporarily locked' and must start again. No link is created. A locked account is rejected before the password is checked.
sonnet.q4: Verified email matching no user: create a user with no password (password_hash NULL), email_verified_at = now, insert a user_identities row, then start_session. Email not verified (and sub unlinked): back to login page saying use email and password; nothing created.
sonnet.q5: Error page, nothing changes. After 12 minutes the state has expired (10 min TTL); a second load of the same callback finds the state already read and deleted (GETDEL, one use only).
sonnet.q6: A normal session via start_session(user_id): a new sessions row and sid cookie (14 days, sliding). It deletes any existing sid session row first, creates a new one, sets the cookie, and redirects to the saved relative next path, else /home.
sonnet.q7: No password and no email match required; start requires a signed-in session and the callback checks the browser is still signed in as the same user (else error page). If the sub is already linked to another user (or this user already has a different Google account), it goes back to settings, refused, with nothing changed. If linked to this same user, 'already linked'.
sonnet.q8: In Redis under key goog:state:<state> (along with entry point, next path, user id for settings), with a 10 min TTL. The callback reads and deletes it in one step (GETDEL), or the TTL expires it.
sonnet.q9: In Redis under goog:link:<id> (holding matched user id, sub, next path, time) with a 10 min TTL, fixed at creation. The browser refers to it by id in a short HttpOnly cookie. It is deleted by a successful confirm, a lockout, or TTL expiry. It never touches PostgreSQL.
sonnet.q10: In PostgreSQL table user_identities (user_id, provider 'google', sub, linked_at). Unique key on (provider, sub) gives one user per Google account; unique key on (user_id, provider) gives one Google account per user.
sonnet.q11: Code exchange failure: back to the start page with 'could not finish, try again'; nothing changes, no tokens stored, the user starts again. Invalid ID token: error page, nothing changes. Retry of the exchange: not retried automatically; the user must start over.
sonnet.q12: The attempt record in Redis stores the entry point (login page or settings) and, for settings, the user id. For settings, the callback checks the browser is still signed in as that same user, otherwise shows the error page; the link is attached to that user.
